newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean president names new prime minister-Yonhap.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean president names new prime minister-Yonhap.

text.p: South Korean President Kim Young-sam on Tuesday appointed a new prime minister, Koh Kun, 59, a former mayor of Seoul and currently head of Myongji University, Yonhap Television News reported.
An official at the presidential Blue House, who declined to be identified, confirmed the report.
Koh's appointment must be approved by the National Assembly. He would replace current premier Lee Soo-sung.
Koh had extensive cabinet experience during the 1980-1988 administration of former president Chun Doo Hwan and was mayor of Seoul from 1988-90 under Chun's successor, Roh Tae-woo.
Kim has launched a major reshuffle of his administration aimed at restoring his reputation badly tarnished by a scandal involving loans to failed Hanbo Steel Co.
